dinner.title: Dinner
dinner.tagline: A three-hour evening, a multi-course menu — selected Turkish dishes served as the Bosphorus lights up.
dinner.menuDetailIntro: A multi-course Turkish menu built around classic meze, a warm starter, a grilled main and dessert. Standard and VIP follow the same arc — VIP widens the meze spread, adds three more hot starters, brings antrikot (ribeye) to the mains and finishes with a baklava and fresh fruit platter.
dinner.block1Desc: Served family-style on a shared platter. Standard (8): tomato & cucumber, white cheese, kısır (bulgur), haydari (strained yoghurt with herbs), fava (broad bean purée), pembe sultan, potato salad, seasonal salad. VIP (12): adds yaprak sarması (stuffed vine leaves), spicy cheese, çiğ köfte (raw köfte) and hamsi (anchovy) to the Standard spread.
dinner.block1Alt: Turkish meze spread served on a candlelit Bosphorus dinner cruise table
dinner.block2Desc: Standard: kalem böreği — slim cigar-shape filo pastry, fried crisp. VIP: a small hot tasting plate — kalem böreği, breaded shrimp, falafel and crispy onion rings, served between meze and main.
dinner.block3Count: Standard: 4 choices · VIP: 5 choices · sides included
dinner.block3Desc: Each guest picks one main; partners can mix categories. All mains are served with rice, mashed potatoes, grilled tomato and pepper. Standard: köfte, chicken, salmon or mixed grill. VIP: adds antrikot (grilled ribeye) on top of the same four.
dinner.dish1Desc: Hand-pressed beef and lamb köfte, grilled to order. Served with rice, mashed potatoes, grilled tomato and pepper.
dinner.dish2Desc: Premium Turkish beef ribeye, grilled to your preferred doneness and rested. Served with rice, mashed potatoes, grilled tomato and pepper. VIP package only.
dinner.dish2Alt: VIP main course on Bosphorus dinner cruise — grilled antrikot ribeye
dinner.dish3Desc: Marinated chicken breast, grilled to order. Served with rice, mashed potatoes, grilled tomato and pepper.
dinner.dish3Alt: Grilled chicken main course served on a Bosphorus dinner cruise
dinner.dish4Desc: Salmon fillet grilled with olive oil, lemon and Mediterranean herbs. Served with rice, mashed potatoes, grilled tomato and pepper.
dinner.dish5Desc: A grilled selection of köfte, chicken and lamb on one platter. Served with rice, mashed potatoes, grilled tomato and pepper.
dinner.block4Count: Standard: baklava · VIP: baklava + fruit platter
dinner.block4Desc: Standard: two pieces of warm pistachio baklava with a light syrup. VIP: the same baklava served alongside a fresh seasonal fruit platter.
dinner.menuFoot: Unlimited soft drinks (water, cola, juice) included in both packages. Unlimited local alcohol available as a +€15 add-on; imported spirits at extra cost. Vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options prepared on board — let us know on booking.

shows.eyebrow: Turkish Night Show · Live on Stage
shows.title: Shows
shows.tagline: A four-act Turkish night programme, performed live every evening between dinner and the DJ — concert-grade lighting, professional performers, no interval.
shows.menuDetailIntro: Performances run from roughly 21:30 to 22:30, while dinner continues at your table. Each act flows into the next — from the serenity of the opening dervish to the energetic peak of the belly dance.
shows.block1Desc: The serene opening of the evening — a Mevlevi sema. The dervish spins in white robes around a central axis, one hand turned to the sky, one to the earth. Originating in 13th-century Konya with the poet Rumi, the dance is both spiritual ritual and theatrical art. A slow, contemplative start before the night builds in energy.
shows.block1Alt: Whirling dervish performance on a Bosphorus dinner cruise — Mevlevi sema
shows.block2Desc: A folk dance company in regional costumes performs across Anatolia's cultural map — Black Sea horon, Aegean zeybek, eastern halay. Energetic, percussive, accompanied by traditional Anatolian instruments. The cultural breadth of Turkey in fifteen minutes.
shows.block2Alt: Anatolian folk dance company performing on Bosphorus dinner cruise deck
shows.block3Desc: A professional percussion ensemble takes the deck — davul, darbuka and bendir layered over each other in driving rhythms. The room's energy lifts; this is where the night turns from observation to participation, guests clapping along, lights washing across the deck.
shows.block3Alt: Live drum ensemble performance on Bosphorus dinner cruise
shows.block4Desc: The evening's centrepiece — a professional belly dancer's full routine, weaving between tables and the stage. Bright sequined costumes, expressive choreography, audience moments with guests pulled gently into the dance. The kind of moment guests photograph and remember for years.
shows.block4Alt: Belly dance performance on Bosphorus dinner cruise — the night's peak
shows.menuFoot: After the four acts, the DJ takes the deck until midnight (see Party). All performers are professionally trained, with full-time stage and music careers — concert-grade lighting and sound across the main deck.

view.title: View
view.tagline: A three-hour cruise across Europe and Asia — bridges, palaces and the illuminated silhouette of Istanbul.
view.photo1Alt: Bosphorus Bridge illuminated at night on a Bosphorus dinner cruise
view.photo2Alt: Dolmabahçe Palace from the water on a Bosphorus night cruise
view.photo3Alt: Ortaköy Mosque on the Bosphorus shore at night
view.photo4Alt: Aerial view of the Bosphorus and Istanbul shoreline at night
view.photo5Alt: Couple under the Bosphorus Bridge on a dinner cruise
view.stop1Desc: Heart of the historic peninsula, where the Bosphorus meets the Golden Horn. Our evening begins here, at our pier with Galata Tower across the water.
view.stop2Desc: Once Galata's harbour, today a vibrant district of European-era architecture, art galleries and waterfront cafés.
view.stop3Desc: Sultan Abdülmecid's grand baroque palace, opened in 1856 — the seat of Ottoman power for the empire's final decades.
view.stop4Desc: The last imperial palace, built for Sultan Abdülaziz in 1871. Today, a luxury hotel rising directly from the strait.
view.stop5Desc: An iconic baroque-revival mosque (1856) whose marble façade is mirrored in the Bosphorus — postcard of Istanbul.
view.stop6Desc: The first bridge to span the strait, opened in 1973. Two continents joined overhead — illuminated nightly in changing colours.
view.stop7Desc: A storied European bay, famed for its waterfront mansions, cafés and elegant promenade — Istanbul's calm corner.
view.stop8Desc: Built in just four months in 1452 by Mehmed II — the fortress that sealed Constantinople's fate before the conquest.
view.stop9Desc: The strait's second bridge (1988), named for Mehmed the Conqueror. Mid-point of the cruise — we turn here for the Asian shore.
view.stop10Desc: The summer palace of the Ottoman sultans (1865), where royal guests were received on the Asian shore.
view.stop11Desc: The Asian heart of Istanbul — ancient Chrysopolis. Mihrimah Sultan Mosque, narrow streets and time-worn quaysides.
view.stop12Desc: A legendary 18th-century tower at the heart of the strait. We pass close enough to see it lit, far enough to keep its mystery.
view.stop13Desc: Back to where the evening began — the pier, the city, the night closing in. Three hours, two continents, one Bosphorus.
view.narrative: On the European side: Dolmabahçe Palace, Çırağan, Ortaköy Mosque, the 15 July Martyrs Bridge in red light. On the Asian side: Beylerbeyi Palace, Kuzguncuk houses, Anadolu Hisarı. At the midpoint, the Fatih Sultan Mehmet Bridge; on the return, Maiden's Tower and the Topkapı silhouette.

party.title: Party
party.tagline: After the Turkish night show, the party shifts to the sky deck — open-air, a resident DJ, dancing under the Bosphorus stars until midnight.
party.menuDetailIntro: No celebrity DJ acts and no laser theatre — just an open-air dance floor on the sky deck, a resident DJ who reads the crowd, and a Bosphorus skyline as backdrop. Dance if you like; the lounge deck stays calm if you don't.
party.block1Desc: As the four-act Turkish night show closes with the belly dance, the lights change and the DJ takes the deck. Dinner service quietens; coffee and drinks continue. Anyone ready to dance moves up to the sky deck — those who prefer to linger over a drink stay at their table.
party.block2Desc: The top of the boat opens to the sky — dance floor in the centre, lounge seating around the edge, the second bar serving cocktails and the Bosphorus on every side. In warmer months the breeze does the cooling; in winter the deck is heated.
party.block2Alt: Sky-deck dance floor on a Bosphorus dinner cruise after the Turkish night show
party.block3Desc: A resident DJ — professional, well practised on this floor, with full sound and lighting at hand. The set leans into whatever the room wants on the night: a young couple's evening reads different to a friends-of-six birthday. No name on a marquee; we'd rather over-deliver than over-promise.
party.block4Desc: A rough weekly cadence we keep to — but the DJ always adapts to the crowd:
party.block4Alt: Guests dancing on a Bosphorus dinner cruise after midnight
party.menuFoot: Private charters available for birthdays, bachelor / bachelorette parties and corporate events — message us on WhatsApp or Telegram for a custom evening. The DJ booth can host a guest DJ if you bring one.

flow.title: An evening,
flow.tagline: From a 21:00 departure at Eminönü Pier to a midnight return — the full Bosphorus arc.
flow.stage1Desc: Doors open at 20:00. Our pier at Eminönü looks out from the historic peninsula onto one of the Bosphorus's most beautiful vistas — framed by the silhouette of Galata Tower. If time allows, watching the sunset from the boat's deck is a pleasure of its own. Once aboard, your reservation is confirmed and, at your private table, the evening opens with our exquisite meze service.
flow.stage2Desc: While you enjoy a variety of seasonal mezes and drinks, your main course is served alongside a seasonal salad. On one side, the Bosphorus's unmatched view; on the other, the stage programme — savour your meal, take in the show, drift into the view; the evening unfolds at the tempo you choose.
flow.stage3Desc: The stage opens with the serenity of a whirling dervish — Anatolian folk dances and a drum ensemble lift the night's energy, climaxing in belly dance. As your dinner continues, a four-act Anatolian evening unfolds before you, all from your table.
flow.stage4Desc: After the show, momentum carries the night forward — the DJ takes over and the dance floor opens. For those seeking calm, the upper deck offers its own pleasure: sip your drink and take in the Bosphorus's colourful panorama; we recommend plenty of photographs. Dance floor or upper deck — until midnight, the choice is yours.

info.title: Frequently
info.tagline: Departure, duration, payment, cancellation policy and frequently asked questions.
info.row5Dd: On the boat · Cash (EUR/TRY/USD) or card
info.row6Dd: Free up to 2 hours before departure
info.faq1A: An evening Bosphorus cruise — we depart at 21:00 and return around midnight. On our three-deck vessel: full dinner, a Turkish night programme (whirling dervish, belly dance, folk, drums), DJ, and unlimited soft drinks. Departing from our pier at Eminönü.
info.faq2A: Soft drinks are included in all packages. For alcohol: an unlimited local package per person at +€15 (beer, rakı, gin, vodka, red & white wine). Imported drinks (champagne, whisky, cognac, etc.) are served at extra cost.
info.faq3Q: Where does the cruise depart from and return to?
info.faq3A: We depart from our pier at Eminönü at 21:00 and return to the same point around midnight. Doors open at 20:00 — feel free to come earlier and enjoy the sunset from the pier.
info.faq4Q: What route does the cruise follow?
info.faq4A: Eminönü → Karaköy → Dolmabahçe → Çırağan → Ortaköy Mosque → Bosphorus Bridge → Bebek → Rumeli Fortress → FSM Bridge → Beylerbeyi → Üsküdar → Maiden's Tower (from afar) → Eminönü. The route may vary depending on weather and sea conditions.
info.faq5Q: Are tables close to the stage?
info.faq5A: The panoramic windows of our salon offer clear Bosphorus views from every seat. The stage is positioned to be visible from all tables. VIP package guests are seated closest to the stage.
info.faq6Q: What shows and entertainment are there?
info.faq6A: A live programme runs throughout the evening: whirling dervishes (a serene opening), Anatolian folk dances, drum ensemble, belly dance (the night's peak), and after dinner, a DJ performance. Concert-grade sound and lighting.
info.faq7Q: Can I book for the same day?
info.faq7A: Yes — same-day bookings are possible up to 1 hour before departure (20:00). Message us on WhatsApp or Telegram and we'll check availability instantly.
info.faq8A: No prepayment is required. All payment is made on board. We accept cash (EUR, TRY, USD) and card.
info.faq9A: Yes — hotel-to-pier-to-hotel transfer is available at +€10 per person. Before the tour, our driver collects you from your hotel and brings you to the pier; after the tour, the same driver waits at the pier and drops you back at your hotel. No need to plan transportation.
info.faq10Q: Can I cancel or change my reservation?
info.faq10A: Free cancellation is possible up to 2 hours before departure (until 19:00). Since there's no prepayment, the process is hassle-free — just send us a message.
info.faq11A: The vessel has a covered salon, semi-open and open decks. In rain, the open deck closes while the salon and stage continue uninterrupted. The cruise runs regardless of weather conditions.
info.faq12Q: Is it suitable for all ages?
info.faq12A: Yes, the cruise is open to guests of all ages. Please contact our reservations team for child pricing and child-friendly menu options.
info.faq13Q: Can you arrange surprises for special occasions?
info.faq13A: Yes — for anniversaries, birthdays, marriage proposals and other special moments, we offer romantic-table, cake & champagne service and professional photography add-ons. You can add them from the Extras section or mention them at reservation.

privacy.title: Your privacy,
privacy.tagline: How we collect, use, and protect your personal data — short, clear, no jargon.
privacy.p1: Luxury Bosphorus Tour ("we", "us") operates this site and the booking conversations on WhatsApp and Telegram. For any privacy-related question, message us through either channel.
privacy.p2: When you reserve, we collect only what we need to confirm and operate your evening:
privacy.li2: The date, package, party size, and any add-ons you've chosen
privacy.li3: Your hotel name / pickup address and optional room number — only when you request hotel transfer
privacy.p3: We do not ask for ID numbers, credit-card data, or any document. Payment is taken on board.
privacy.li5: To confirm your reservation and hold your table
privacy.li6: To coordinate hotel pickup, when applicable
privacy.li7: To reach you with last-minute updates (weather, time changes)
privacy.p4: Only with the staff who need it to deliver your evening:
privacy.li9: Our transfer driver, if you've chosen hotel pickup — receives only your hotel / room and name
privacy.li10: Our reception team at the pier, to recognise your reservation
privacy.p5: We do not sell, rent, or trade your data. We do not pass anything to advertisers.
privacy.h5: Third-party services used on this site
privacy.li11: Google Fonts — for typography (no personal data is sent)
privacy.li12: OpenStreetMap — only when you search for your hotel; the search query is sent to OSM's Nominatim service to return results
privacy.li13: WhatsApp / Telegram — when you tap "Confirm via …" you continue the booking in their respective apps; their own privacy policies then apply
privacy.p6: Active booking conversations are kept while customer support remains useful — typically up to 12 months after your evening. After that, personal details are deleted.
privacy.p7: You can ask us to see, correct, or delete any data we hold about you. Message us on WhatsApp or Telegram and we'll process the request promptly.
privacy.p8: This site does not set tracking cookies. Your browser may locally cache fonts and map tiles for performance.

terms.title: Booking
terms.tagline: The basic rules of the evening — what we promise, what we ask in return.
terms.p1: A reservation is held when we confirm it on WhatsApp or Telegram and send you a confirmation message. We accept guests up to one hour before departure, subject to availability. No prepayment is required.
terms.p2: Departure is at 21:00 from our pier at Eminönü. Doors open at 20:00 — please arrive in good time. The cruise runs for three hours and returns to the same pier around midnight.
terms.p3: Prices shown on this site are valid at booking. Adults pay full price, kids aged 4–7 pay half, babies aged 0–3 are free. Add-ons (transfer, alcohol, romantic table) are calculated per booking. Payment is taken on board in cash (EUR, TRY, USD) or by card.
terms.p4: If you choose pickup, our driver collects you at the hotel time we agree on WhatsApp. We need your hotel name and a confirmed pickup window. The same driver drops you back after the cruise.
terms.p5: Free cancellation is available up to 2 hours before departure. See our Cancellation policy for details.
terms.p6: The cruise runs in almost all weather. In rare storm conditions the route may be shortened or the evening rescheduled — you are entitled to a free reschedule or to walk away with no charge.
terms.p7: We welcome a lively evening, but we reserve the right to refuse boarding to anyone who is significantly intoxicated, behaves aggressively, or endangers other guests or crew. The captain's authority is final at sea.
terms.p8: Operations are governed by Turkish maritime and consumer law. We carry full passenger insurance for the cruise.
terms.p9: You may photograph and film for personal use. If we want to publish any image that identifies guests, we will ask first.
terms.p10: We may update these terms from time to time. The version published on this page at the time of your booking is the one that applies to you.

cancellation.title: Cancellation
cancellation.tagline: How free cancellation works and what happens in special cases.
cancellation.p1: Cancel for any reason — no questions, no fee — up to 2 hours before departure (i.e. by 19:00 on the evening of your cruise). Since we don't take prepayment, there's nothing to refund and nothing to chase. Just message us.
cancellation.p2: Reply to the WhatsApp or Telegram thread you used to book, or start a new message — name and date are enough for us to find your reservation. Confirmation arrives within minutes during operating hours.
cancellation.p3: If you cancel after 19:00 or simply don't arrive, we don't chase a charge — but the table is held until departure and another guest cannot use it. Please send us a quick note when you can; it helps the table go to someone else.
cancellation.p4: If we cancel due to weather, captain's call, or vessel availability, we offer you either a free reschedule for any future evening within 6 months, or a full release if you've already paid anything in advance.
cancellation.p5: You can change your date, guest count, or package up to 4 hours before departure, subject to availability. Date changes are free; upgrades pay the difference; downgrades follow the current published rates.
cancellation.p6: Most evenings carry no prepayment, so refunds rarely apply. In the few cases where a deposit was taken (private yacht, large groups), refunds are made through the same channel as the payment within 5 working days of the cancellation request.

boat.title: Our Boat
boat.tagline: A premium three-deck Bosphorus cruise vessel — capacity, layout and what's where on board.
boat.menuDetailIntro: Each deck plays a different role across the evening — climate-controlled dining and stage downstairs, intimate window-side tables in the middle, an open-air dance floor and bar above.
boat.block1Desc: The heart of the cruise — full restaurant seating, the stage at the front, dance floor at the centre. This is where the Turkish night show runs, and where the main bar lives. Climate-controlled, with panoramic windows on both sides.
boat.block1Alt: Main deck dining hall on a Bosphorus dinner cruise
boat.block2Desc: A lounge-style dining floor above the main deck — quieter, window-side tables with direct views over the strait, ideal for couples and small groups. Same menu, same show audio through concealed speakers, less crowd energy.
boat.block3Desc: The top of the boat — open to the sky, with lounge seating, a second bar and the DJ booth. After the show, the night shifts here: dance floor, drinks under the stars, the Bosphorus on every side. Heating in cooler months.
boat.block3Alt: Sky deck open-air dance floor on a Bosphorus dinner cruise after dark
boat.menuFoot: Boarding opens at 20:00 from our pier at Eminönü. The captain's authority is final at sea; we follow Turkish maritime law and carry full passenger insurance.
